method: Read current source text in full for new candidate/reference/tests and modified label modules; full pre-edit graph plus all exact adapter changes and unchanged caller context reviewed. Static textual legacy field-list comparison, map IDs and method names only. No candidate import/compilation/execution.

findings.title: V01-22 group weights contradict frozen unit mass per date
findings.finding: Candidate and independent reference divide by number of groups as well as rows per group. With1000 A rows and1 B row they return1/2000 and1/2, while the frozen case requires1/1000 and1. The test retains the correct frozen expectation and is predicted to fail.
findings.proposed_repair: Repair both independently to the predeclared unit mass per group; preserve the golden and test expectations.

findings.title: Typed payload and real ledger adapters are incomplete
findings.finding: LabelOutcome validates a payload_kind tag but accepts any canonical JSON, including a generic scalar or numeric full-horizon payload in a censored record. OI/policy adapters return dictionaries rather than a typed ledger outcome. V01-14 stores object departure under price_path; V01-31 retains only the candidate and does not append/reconcile an actual policy nonfill outcome.
findings.proposed_repair: Add bounded per-kind payload schemas and explicit adapters returning retained LabelOutcome/ObservationEvidence records; ensure censored full-horizon fields remain null and policy/receipt provenance is retained. Complete corresponding real ledger tests without implementing root reward math.

findings.title: Several resource checks happen after allocation or decoding
findings.finding: Ledger wire trees/checkpoint bytes are built before their byte bound is checked; restore constructs all encoded tuple records before cardinality checks; models._training materializes examples before temporal capacity validation; compatible_gap_evidence sorts/materializes points before4096 check. ObservationEvidence gaps/partial facts and future_profile_mass have no explicit collection preflight. These are finite eventually in many paths but do not satisfy the registered before-allocation contract.
findings.proposed_repair: Introduce bounded structural preflight/counting before serialization, restore construction and iterable materialization. Apply the same finite configuration to adjacent payload collections and direct temporal model callers.

findings.title: Configurable limits cannot actually increase beyond constructor defaults
findings.finding: V01V02LimitsV1 accepts any positive explicit limit, while record constructors hard-code default256-byte IDs,64 dependencies/parents,4096 population and65536-byte payload bounds. A registered upward local override fails before the supplied configuration can validate it; F11 must still retain its existing lower limits.
findings.proposed_repair: Separate minimal typed-record validation from explicit service limits, or obtain an explicit root contract disposition for hard maxima. Do not silently claim upward configurable behavior.

findings.title: Capacity variants do not exactly cover all registered service boundaries
findings.finding: Checkpoint test accepts a default-limit snapshot then rejects under changed B-1 configuration; it does not demonstrate an otherwise valid snapshot accepted at exact B with matching retained limits. Payload test exercises bounded_json directly rather than ledger append. Total-dependency variant uses one row rather than the frozen two-row total-bound fixture. Small-cap tests are otherwise present for all13 names.
findings.proposed_repair: Use independently encoded valid checkpoint/ledger record bytes and matching retained limit values for exact capacity and one-over variants; use two rows for the total dependency bound and preserve state bytes after rejection.

findings.title: Actual temporal missing-route negative currently fails on absent graph ID
findings.finding: The clean temporal producer/downstream route is fully constructed. The missing-route mutation replaces the consumer fold node but leaves downstream requests/fit edges referring to the old fold ID; badrequest is computed but unused. It therefore proves missing-node rejection, not the intended explicit producer-route gate.
findings.proposed_repair: Rebuild the affected read/fit/model IDs and coherent requests for the route-free fold, or construct an independent consistent bad closure, so the actual route check is reached.

findings.title: V01-20 reconciliation loses exact missing and duplicate IDs
findings.finding: Current failures say only required candidate outcome omitted or duplicate identity. The frozen case calls for exact missing b and duplicate b diagnostics. Tests assert ContractError only, so they do not enforce the registered diagnostics.
findings.proposed_repair: Return or attach deterministic exact missing/duplicate identity evidence and assert the frozen b diagnostics in both cases.

findings.title: Independent reference coverage is narrower than the registered64-case requirement
findings.finding: Reference arithmetic exists for paths, exact object paths, compatible gap orders, temporal eligibility, group weights, OI queries, episode resets, censor bounds and old wire encoding. Many ledger/reconciliation/checkpoint/phase/route cases assert hand constants or candidate behavior only and have no independent literal result comparison. The case map names every64 method but must not imply complete literal-reference fidelity yet.
findings.proposed_repair: Add independent primitive ledger/reconciliation/phase/route reference checks and connect applicable existing methods, preserving all registered expected values. Keep declarations vs actual F11 proof distinctions explicit.

findings.title: OI endpoint accepts a revision for another position date
findings.finding: The receipt chain checks contract and supersedes linkage but not common endpoint position_date, ordering relative to prior position_date, or an initial unexpected supersedes value. A linked record for a different endpoint can replace the requested report delta.
findings.proposed_repair: Freeze and validate the next-report endpoint identity independently of receipt revision ID, and reject mismatched position dates/first predecessor evidence with a same-case revision variant.

findings.title: Retained legacy wire test depends on mutable temporary draft path
findings.finding: The old wire schema is loaded directly from /tmp/v01-v02-legacy-wire-schema-draft.json without verifying its registered SHA. Registration retained the exact bytes, but the test should read that retained artifact or a pinned repo copy so later temp deletion/change cannot substitute reference evidence.
findings.proposed_repair: Use the registered retained byte reference or a pinned repository fixture and verify806d6339... before comparing old-wire vectors. Do not regenerate expected bytes from candidate dataclasses.

findings.title: Malformed observation identity still accepts non-string version
findings.finding: The tightened legacy observation validation checks only truthiness of version, so a positive integer version remains accepted. Existing ObjectTarget likewise accepts bool side and untyped truthy identity values. V01-17 only tests an empty string, leaving the exact typed/canonical metadata requirement incomplete.
findings.proposed_repair: Tighten only malformed-input type checks and add same-case malformed variants; preserve all valid legacy signatures and serialized fields.

findings.title: Frozen temporal tamper variants are only partially asserted
findings.finding: Tests cover forged fit membership, wrong request end, dependency bytes changed under old hash and wrong actual label end. They do not independently exercise a dependency record changed while its original retained bytes stay intact, matching hash/metadata tamper detection, actual label maturity mismatch, or explicit early fit_label/fit_feature admission of excluded a. Existing F11 code retains those gates, but the new typed path requires its own assertions.
findings.proposed_repair: Complete these same-case actual commit/read/restore tamper variants and isolate each intended gate with otherwise consistent evidence.

completion_claim: Initial implementation and initial static review only. Open findings require the root consolidated batch repair before shared execution; no semantic pass or scientific/economic completion claim.
